source.name: UP NOAH 100-year flood hazard, Bulacan
source.crs: GCS_WGS_1984 — same datum as the DPWH coordinates, no reprojection

caveat: Outside the modelled extent is not 'unnecessary'. A revetment or floodwall belongs at the edge of a flood zone, and the model boundary is itself approximate. NOAH models fluvial flooding and does not claim to cover every drainage or coastal mechanism.
